chunks: And Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليه السلام said:
"Comb yourselves with ivory, for it removes ailments."

key_terms.بِالْعَاجِ: with ivory; using a comb made of ivory
key_terms.تَمَشَّطُوا: Comb your hair; groom yourselves with a comb

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليه السلام say about combing with ivory?
ai.summary: Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليه السلام recommends combing with ivory, presenting it as beneficial in warding off illness. The narration reflects teachings on cleanliness, grooming, and bodily well-being.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.322 - Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as) said:
"Comb your hair with combs made of ivory, for it removes ailments."
